purpose: Review-only proof that the selected M2 player can be baked at 120 real three-degree world-yaw angles in a compact 20 by 6 layout while the body and rifle remain separate 3D source objects and the depth-correct composite remains the runtime recommendation.
camera: one measured orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: 120 real world-yaw samples from 0 through 357 degrees in exact 3-degree steps; no mirroring
lighting: identical controlled fixed-world key, fill, and rim lighting across all angles and layer passes
prompt: Bake the selected M2 industrial salvage alloy player in the approved READY pose at 120 true world-yaw angles. Preserve the exact 45-degree camera, automatic LOD bake candidate, two-hand grip, shoulder-stock contact, and independent BoneAttachment3D rifle. Produce one shared-depth composite atlas plus body-only and weapon-only diagnostic atlases.
negative_constraints: no screen-space weapon rotation, 2D mirroring, baked-in source rifle, horizontal camera, or camera orbit
no body or weapon geometry change, pose drift, translucent character mass, detached hand, floating stock, or cropped silhouette
do not claim that body-only plus weapon-only alpha compositing reproduces correct per-pixel depth; the composite atlas is the depth-correct output
no Player.gd change, production atlas replacement, collision change, gameplay integration, or promotion of automatic LOD as hand-authored retopology

references.role: approved automatic LOD candidate for offline sprite baking
accepted A2 geometry, attachment, and exact-camera proof

candidate_outputs.focus: depth-correct body and rifle result from one 3D viewport
independent rifle-only authoring and diagnostic layer

generation_model: Godot 4.7 deterministic Skeleton3D and SubViewport rendering using the selected M2 ShaderMaterial, separate BoneAttachment3D rifle, one shared 3D depth buffer for composites, and recoverable twelve-angle batches

style_lock_reference.mode: deterministic expansion of approved M2; no new generated style reference
style_lock_reference.prompt_summary: selected M2, READY pose, exact 45-degree camera, real 3-degree world rotation
style_lock_reference.invariants: identity, M2 material, body geometry, weapon geometry, grip, scale, pose, camera, lighting, and framing
